decisions.reason: A net price display plugin is a simple shop extension the firm can maintain cheaply, though it sits at the edge of its marketing knowledge base.
An ERP interface draws on integration knowledge less related to the firm's advertising and market research core, so it is the hardest to interpret and improve, but one year is too early to judge.
Price comparison tracking builds directly on the firm's marketing analytics expertise, so it can read the tracking results and learn from them to improve the product.
This tracking plugin shares a code base and know-how with the other tracking plugins, so the firm absorbs feedback efficiently and maintenance costs stay low.
It is closely related to the firm's core competence in campaign and price-portal tracking, though it carries some risk of consolidation within the plugin family.
Net price reporting links to the firm's reporting and analytics skills, which supports keeping it, though its demand is less certain than that of the tracking plugins.
